result.evidence_quote: When PD-1 blockade is introduced concomitantly with vaccination, after, rather than during, axitinib treatment, the triple regimen (axitinib + [SVX + anti-PD-1]) achieves durable tumor control with a high rate of complete responses, outperforming all other treatment schedules.
result.rationale: The abstract directly investigates experimental renal carcinoma treatment, showing how sequencing VEGFR inhibition, tumor-antigen vaccination, and PD-1 blockade improves tumor control. It also explains the vascular and immune mechanisms underlying therapeutic efficacy, matching the profile’s interest in cancer biology and treatments.
